headline: Beech Street Elementary school report card, chronic absenteeism attendance data, and updated student conduct codes and definitions.
summary: The meeting covers a school report card presentation for Beech Street Elementary School. It also includes attendance data on chronic absenteeism and updated student conduct codes and definitions, all for information only.

AGENDA 
 
MANCHESTER SCHOOL DISTRICT SAU #37 
 
COMMITTEE ON STUDENT CONDUCT 
 
September 16, 2026 5:00 p.m.  
Committee Members Hamer, Want, Stewart, Bergeron and St. John Aldermanic Chambers  
Alternates:  Committee Members Taylor and Smith City Hall (3 rd Floor) 
Student Representatives:  Madison Hanneman (MST) and Taegan 
Whyte (MST) 
 
 
1. Chair Hamer calls the meeting to order.  
 
2. The Clerk calls the roll.  
 
3. Public Forum 
 
4. Chair Hamer advises that the purpose of the public forum is to give the residents of Manchester 
the opportunity to address the committee on items of concerns affecting the community; each 
person will be given only one opportunity to speak; comments shall be limited to three minutes to 
allow all participants the opportunity to speak and any comments must be directed to the Chair. 
Any resident wishing to speak will come forward to the nearest microphone, clearly state their 
name and address when recognized and give their comments.  
 
5. Chair Hamer advises that if there is no one else present to speak and there are no other public 
comments that have been submitted, a motion would be in order to take all comments under 
advisement and to further receive and file any written documentation presented.  
 
 
6. Approval of the Minutes of the following meeting: August 19, 2026 
 Ladies and Gentlemen, what is your pleasure?
